result.justification: The objectives are stated, emphasizing the assessment of 'the regional macroeconomic and environmental impacts of continuous energy efficiency improvements in Türkiye.' However, the methodology lacks explicit details such as analytical procedures and sample size.

evidence.quote: This study develops a recursive dynamic Türkiye Energy Nexus Subnational Computable General Equilibrium (T-EN) model to assess the regional macroeconomic and environmental impacts of continuous energy efficiency improvements in Türkiye.
A key contribution of this study lies in the construction of a Multi-Regional Social Accounting Matrix (MRSAM) of the model that features a detailed disaggregation of the energy sectors.
